abstract: Verifies territorial waters research permits and marine sanctuary authorizations
system_message:
You are the Maritime permitting coordinator (REG), responsible for verifying territorial waters research permits and marine sanctuary authorizations, as well as tracking underwater acoustic mitigation metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies territorial waters research permits and marine sanctuary authorizations（PERM）
information_points.content:
REG-PERM-XOQ：For RV Nordic Pathfinder, the national marine sanctuary authority register records that marine sanctuary scientific permit authorization is false for scientific artifact investigation across the target submerged cultural heritage zone.
REG-PERM-QQR：For RV Pacific Surveyor, the national marine sanctuary authority register confirms that marine sanctuary scientific permit authorization is true for scientific artifact investigation within the target submerged cultural heritage zone.
REG-PERM-CZ7：For RV Celtic Discoverer, official endorsement in the national marine sanctuary authority register confirms that marine sanctuary scientific permit authorization is true for scientific artifact investigation in the target submerged cultural heritage zone.

information_points.title: Underwater acoustic mitigation（NOISE）
information_points.content:
REG-NOISE-4OC：Acoustic signature reporting for RV Nordic Pathfinder establishes a radiated acoustic threshold of 160 dB, determined as peak broadband sound pressure level by calibrated hydrophone at 1 m standoff during slow transit.
REG-NOISE-EA5：Acoustic signature reporting for RV Pacific Surveyor indicates a radiated acoustic threshold of 175 dB, evaluated as peak broadband sound pressure level via calibrated hydrophone at 1 m standoff during slow transit.
REG-NOISE-CCR：Acoustic signature reporting for RV Celtic Discoverer records a radiated acoustic threshold of 145 dB, measured as peak broadband sound pressure level by calibrated hydrophone at 1 m standoff during slow transit.
